validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <state id="a"><onentry><send target="#_internal"/></onentry><transition event="go" target="f"/></state><final id="f"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `<send>` to the SCXML event processor names no event
notes: the SCXML Event I/O Processor delivers a named event, so a `<send>` it handles must have `event` or `eventexpr`; without them the send raises `error.execution` instead of delivering anything
diagnostics.help: add `event="name"` with the event to deliver, or `eventexpr` to compute it
